question: What is the comparison rate for someone borrowing 85% of the value?
reply:
At LVR 80.01% to 90%, the interest rate is 6.44% p.a. and the comparison rate is 6.47% p.a.

This is from the page on examplelender.com.au, read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time. Note that rates are subject to change without notice per the document, so it's worth reading the page again if this is being used for anything beyond today.
